rules.description: Applicant must have an existing driving licence or have lost/stolen licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have an existing driving licence to change the name. Apply for a new licence if you have never held one.

rules.description: Applicant must have legal evidence of name change
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide original evidence of your name change (marriage certificate, civil partnership certificate, deed poll, or statutory declaration). Photocopies are not accepted.

rules.description: Applicant must be a UK resident (excluding Northern Ireland for this service)
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for England, Wales and Scotland residents only. Northern Ireland has a different process.

rules.description: Evidence documents must not be laminated
rules.reason_if_failed: Laminated certificates cannot be accepted. You must provide original, unlaminated documents.

rules.description: If applicant has paper licence, must provide passport-type photo
rules.reason_if_failed: You have a paper driving licence, so you must send a recent printed passport-type photo with your application.

edge_cases.description: Licence has been lost, stolen or destroyed
edge_cases.action: Applicant must explain what happened on form D1. Fee of £20 applies, payable to DVLA by cheque or postal order.

edge_cases.description: Applicant wants to change photo at the same time as name
edge_cases.action: Fee of £17 applies (unless over 70 or medical short period licence). Must send recent printed passport-type photo. Cheque or postal order payable to DVLA.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is over 70 or has medical short period licence
edge_cases.action: No fee for photo change. Still must send photo if changing photo.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a lorry or bus licence
edge_cases.action: Use form D2 'Application for a lorry/bus licence'. Send to DVLA Swansea SA99 1BR (different address from car/motorbike).

edge_cases.description: Applicant is also changing gender on licence
edge_cases.action: Same process as name change. Provide evidence of gender change. No additional fee.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is changing title to a hereditary title
edge_cases.action: Evidence required for hereditary titles (e.g. Lord, Lady). No evidence needed for standard titles (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, etc).
Reminder: You must also update your V5C vehicle registration certificate (log book) if you own a vehicle.
